title: Specify MQTT CLAIM/LEASE/RELEASE envelope fields in Gherkin (do not defer to REALTIME.md)
description:
SD nit #3 on PR #278: some MQTT Then steps defer to docs/REALTIME.md instead of naming concrete envelope fields.

Gherkin is the source of truth. Cite topic/envelope fields in the scenarios so dual-runtime steps can be written without reading the docs as a spec.
right_now_summary: The MQTT Gherkin scenarios still need concrete CLAIM, LEASE, and RELEASE envelope fields.
